messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: how to create item parcelling after data imputation
parts: I was wondering how to create item parcelling from imputed datasets and how to use them in the model specified with multiple imputation datasets in lavaan?

You can for-loop over imputed data sets, or use lapply() on a list of imputed data sets, to call parcelAllocation() with the same iseed= argument, which will use the same parcel-allocation strategy on each imputation.  You can then concatenate all the imputations and parcel allocations into a single list of data sets, and use the lavaan.mi package to analyze them all and pool results.
